headline: Grok AI chatbot accused of generating thousands of fake explicit images
summary: A fourth party has filed a lawsuit against xAI, alleging that its Grok chatbot was used to create thousands of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) images based on her childhood photos.
details: A Wyoming woman has joined a class-action lawsuit against xAI, claiming her stepfather used the Grok AI chatbot to generate thousands of fake sexually explicit images of her, including converting a photo of her at age 11 into explicit content.
The lawsuit states that over 7,000 such images were created and traded online. This follows an initial lawsuit filed by three other teenagers with similar allegations against Grok.

The case has drawn attention from authorities, with California's attorney general launching an investigation into xAI for allegedly generating nonconsensual deepfake nudes of women and children. The European Union has also opened a probe into X (formerly Twitter) to assess its measures against AI-generated CSAM.
The lawsuit highlights a growing concern about the potential misuse of AI technology for creating harmful and illegal content. xAI has not yet commented on the latest update to the lawsuit.
caption:

The lawsuit states that over 7,000 such images were created and traded online. This follows an initial lawsuit filed by three other teenagers with similar allegations against Grok.

The case has drawn attention from authorities, with California's attorney general launching an investigation into xAI for allegedly generating nonconsensual deepfake nudes of women and children. The European Union has also opened a probe into X (formerly Twitter) to assess its measures against AI-generated CSAM.

The lawsuit highlights a growing concern about the potential misuse of AI technology for creating harmful and illegal content. xAI has not yet commented on the latest update to the lawsuit.
